about.title: Our Mission: Accelerating Your Mastery.
about.paragraph1: In the world of technology, knowing is not enough. You have to know how to *do*. Yet most courses stop at theory, leaving you with a gap between what you learned and what you need to accomplish.
about.paragraph2: **Katalyst** was created to bridge that gap. We believe skill is born from deliberate practice. That is why we built a unique learning platform that immerses you in simulated environments and real scenarios. You do not just watch, you manipulate. You do not just read, you build.
about.paragraph3: Our goal is to transform the way you learn professional tools, moving from passive assimilation to active skill acquisition. So that you are not only ready, but truly operational.
about.imageAlt: An image representing technology and learning

features.title: Skill through practice.
features.intro: Katalyst is built around a simple principle: the best way to learn is to practice. That is why we designed features that immerse you in real scenarios for accelerated mastery of the essentials.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: Reference of the enforced rights. Your current role:
roles.rightsDescriptionAfter: , in every action and every route. They are not configurable for now: this page describes them, it does not change them.
roles.superAdminNote: "Super Admin" can never be assigned from an organization: it is a platform role, and granting it to a client would give them rights over the entire service.
roles.descSuperAdmin: Administration of the Katalyst platform itself. Never assignable by an organization.
roles.descOwner: Responsible for the organization. Can do everything in it, including appointing other administrators.
roles.descAdmin: Administers the organization. Cannot appoint an Owner or another Admin.
roles.descModerator: Manages the educational content. Cannot administer members.
roles.descUser: Takes the courses. No access to administration.

home.feature2Description: Understand the *why* behind every click. Our clear visuals and explanations turn abstract concepts into concrete knowledge.
home.feature3Description: Prove your expertise with quizzes and final projects that confirm you know not only what to do, but also how to do it.
